block.projecthero.ward_gong.hint: A Temple Ward. A tripwire hooked to it, a redstone signal or a strike booms it and wakes the guardians (the alarm). Goes quiet once its ward stone is sabotaged.
block.projecthero.ward_plate.hint: A glyph tile in a temple floor. Tread on it and the guardians wake (the alarm). Sneak over it, or step round it.
block.projecthero.dart_trap.hint: Fires a poisoned dart along its line when you cross it. Knee-high mouths: jump over the line. Head-high mouths: crouch under it. Mine it to disarm it.
block.projecthero.crumbling_floor.hint: Cracked flagstone over a pit. Stand on it and it shakes, then falls away a moment later. It settles back after a while. Keep moving, or take the solid ledge.
block.projecthero.glyph_plate.hint: Walk the four glyph plates in the order the mural shows: the glyph with one candle under it first, then two, three and four. A wrong step puts every plate out.
block.projecthero.temple_mirror.hint: A one-sided mirror at 45 degrees. Right-click to turn it a quarter. Turn the mirrors until the Sun Lens's beam reaches the Seal of Light.
block.projecthero.sun_lens.hint: Throws a beam of sunlight straight out of its face. Mirrors turn it; any other block stops it.
block.projecthero.temple_seal.hint: One of the Hall of Trials' three seals: the Seal of Glyphs, of Light and of Weight. Solve its trial and it cracks open. All three broken open the way on.
block.projecthero.temple_seal.glyph: Seal of Glyphs: walk the glyph plates in the mural's order (count the candles).
block.projecthero.temple_seal.light: Seal of Light: turn the mirrors until the Sun Lens's beam strikes this seal.
block.projecthero.temple_seal.weight: Seal of Weight: balance the bronze scale with the urns' weights.
block.projecthero.temple_seal.glyph_wron: The glyphs go dark. Start again from the first.
block.projecthero.temple_seal.cracked.gl: The Seal of Glyphs cracks open!
block.projecthero.temple_seal.cracked.li: The Seal of Light cracks open!
block.projecthero.temple_seal.cracked.we: The Seal of Weight cracks open!
block.projecthero.weight_altar.hint: A bronze scale. Right-click with temple weights to lay them on the pan: it balances at seven. Sneak with an empty hand to take them back.
block.projecthero.weight_altar.tipped: Too heavy (%s of %s)! The scale tips and throws the weights back.
block.projecthero.temple_gate.hint: A stone slab that sinks away when its trial is done: the three seals, the Tomb Sentinel, or Ankhatep himself.
block.projecthero.temple_gate.trials: Sealed by the three trials. Break all three seals.
block.projecthero.temple_gate.crypt: Sealed until the Tomb Sentinel falls.
block.projecthero.temple_gate.vault: Sealed until the Bound King falls.
block.projecthero.crusher_core.start: The walls begin to move! Run!
block.projecthero.temple_crusher.hint: The Crushing Corridor's walls. Step into the corridor and they close in, a step every few seconds. Run it in about ten seconds: hurdle the low wall, crouch under the slab.
block.projecthero.canopic_jar.hint: Anchors Ankhatep's curse. Fragile: a hit or two, or any arrow, shatters it. Break all four to lift the curse.
block.projecthero.temple_vault_seal.hint: Opens into a Tier 4 Dungeon Vault when Ankhatep falls.
block.projecthero.temple_vault_seal.lock: Bound by Ankhatep's power. Defeat the Bound King to open it.
item.projecthero.temple_weight.hint: Lay it on the Hall of Trials' Weight Altar. The scale balances at %s.
item.projecthero.bound_kings_ankh.hint: Carried: refuses your death once. A killing blow leaves you on 4 hearts with Regeneration, and a burst of sand hurls nearby foes away. Then it sleeps for ten minutes.
item.projecthero.bound_kings_ankh.note: Not against the void. Only the first ankh counts.
item.projecthero.bound_kings_ankh.saved: The Bound King's Ankh refuses your death!
projecthero.temple.trials_done: The three seals are broken. The trials gate sinks into the floor.
projecthero.temple.sentinel.rise: The Tomb Sentinel calls the dead up out of the water!
projecthero.temple.sentinel.down: The Tomb Sentinel falls. The crypt's gate grinds open.
projecthero.temple.cleared.title: Temple Cleared
projecthero.temple.cleared.chat: The Bound King is gone for good. His treasury lies open behind the throne.
projecthero.temple.ankhatep.awake: Ankhatep wakes on his throne. "Who dares the Hall of the Bound?"
projecthero.temple.ankhatep.cursed: The Curse of the Bound King drains your life. Break the four canopic jars!
projecthero.temple.ankhatep.curse_lifted: The last jar shatters: the curse is lifted and Ankhatep staggers!
projecthero.temple.ankhatep.chains: Ankhatep tears his chains apart! The jars re-form round the throne.
projecthero.temple.book.guide.p1:
To whoever reads this:

The Bound King sleeps below. Turn back.

If you will not: the temple's wards are awake. The gongs and the glyph tiles in the floors cry out to the guardians. Step round the tiles, or tread softly (sneak).
projecthero.temple.book.guide.p2:
The halls are trapped.

Faces carved low in the walls spit darts at the knees: jump their line. Faces carved high spit at the head: crouch.

The cracked floor beyond falls into a pit. Keep moving, or hug the east ledge.
projecthero.temple.book.guide.p3:
The Hall of Trials holds three seals. Each trial is explained on a lectern there.

Then the Crushing Corridor: the walls move the moment you step in. Do not stop.
projecthero.temple.book.guide.p4:
The Sentinel keeps the drowned crypt. The captain of the guard carries the seal key to the king's door.

The king's curse is bound to his canopic jars. Break them.
projecthero.temple.book.trials.p1:
THE THREE TRIALS

Break the Seals of Glyphs, Light and Weight and the south gate will open.
projecthero.temple.book.trials.p2:
GLYPHS

The west wall shows four glyphs. Under each burn candles: one, two, three, four.

Walk the glyph plates in that order. A wrong step puts them all out.
projecthero.temple.book.trials.p3:
LIGHT

The Sun Lens in the east wall throws a beam. Right-click the mirrors to turn them, a quarter at a time, until the beam strikes the Seal of Light.
projecthero.temple.book.trials.p4:
WEIGHT

The urns hold four stone weights: Feather 1, Ibis 2, Jackal 3, Lion 4. The scale balances at seven, as the seven candles beside it say.

Too heavy and it throws them back.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.temple.body: A huge temple in jungles and deserts (mossy stone or sandstone): a three-tier ziggurat over a deep descent. A Dungeon Locator can point to it. Allow 10-15 minutes.
The Antechamber (dart traps, a collapsing floor over a pit), the Hall of Trials (three seals), the Crushing Corridor (walls close in: a timed run), the Flooded Crypt (the Tomb Sentinel), the Hall of the Bound (the Captain and his seal key) and the Throne of the Bound King.
The temple's alarm. Ward Gongs (tripwires hooked to them) and Ward Plates in the floor wake the guardians: doors seal and guardians rise out of the sand. Sneak over the plates, step round the wires, kill the runner before he reaches a ward stone, or sabotage the stones. Reach the treasury without waking them for the Ghost bonus.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.temple.trials: Glyphs: walk the glyph plates in the order the mural's candles count (1-4). Light: turn the mirrors until the Sun Lens's beam reaches the Seal of Light. Weight: lay the urns' weights on the scale until it balances at seven. A lectern in the hall explains each.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.temple.foes.b: Temple Guardians (jackal masks, khopesh; Shield-bearers and the Captain), Wrapped Revenants (slow, their grip starves), Cult Acolytes (Runners, Medics, and Snipers with bows). The Tomb Sentinel guards the crypt: a crushing slam (jump it), a charge through the water, and at half health the dead rise to help him.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.temple.ankhat: An undead sorcerer-king chained before his throne. His curse drains you while any of the four canopic jars stands: break them (a hit or an arrow each) to lift it and stagger him. Jump his Sand Wave, step aside from his Sand Lances, deal with the guardians he raises. At half health he breaks his chains, two jars re-form, and he walks free.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.temple.cleari: Ankhatep's death clears the temple for good and opens the three Treasury vaults behind his throne: Tier 4 Dungeon Vaults, everyone gets their own roll.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.temple.artifa: The Bound King's Ankh (Legendary, sometimes in its vaults): carried, it refuses your death once, then sleeps for ten minutes.
projecthero.guide.loot.temple.body: The second Tier 4 dungeon: a buried temple in jungles and deserts with three trials, traps, Temple Wards and Ankhatep, the Bound King. Its treasury holds three Dungeon Vaults and, sometimes, the Bound King's Ankh. See Villain Hideouts for the full guide.
projecthero.guide.structures.temple: Ancient Temple: a ziggurat over a deep descent in jungles and deserts, the second Tier 4 dungeon. See Villain Hideouts.
projecthero.jei.temple: From the Ancient Temple (Tier 4 dungeon, jungles and deserts).
